ask: muse mkae the pairs for secret snata plz
sentence: Randomly pairs everyone in the chat so each person gives one gift and gets one, with nobody drawing themselves, and lets each person privately reveal only their own match.
use_when: A group wants to set up a gift exchange with secret assignments
Someone asks to make Secret Santa pairs for the chat
Each person needs to see only who they give to
A holiday or office gift swap needs a fair random draw
dont_use_when: The group wants to split a bill or track who owes what
Teams or groups of several people are needed instead of one-to-one pairs
Fewer than three people are in the chat
The pairs should be public or chosen by hand
